final: WITH counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), shares AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), ranked AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS excess, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS share_rank FROM shares) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess FROM ranked WHERE excess > 0 AND share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY excess DESC, circuitId
